rows.note: Use 衝動 as the all-purpose noun for an irresistible inner urge to do something.

example.english: I know I’ll go bankrupt if I keep buying, but once that compulsion hits, I can’t stop.
example.traditional: 我明知再買落去會破產，但嗰股衝動一嚟就停唔到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 zi1 zoi3 maai5 lok6 heoi3 wui5 po3 caan2 daan6 go2 gu2 cung1 dung6 jat1 lai4 zau6 ting4 m4 dou3

rows.traditional: 用 A 逼 B V
rows.note: Use this everyday pattern when someone uses authority, influence, or another means to force another person to act.

example.english: The boss used the promise of a promotion to force me to work overtime—that was pure compulsion.
example.traditional: 老闆用升職逼我幫佢加班。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 jung6 sing1 zik1 bik1 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 gaa1 baan1
